titleEn: Resize a ring and collect it
canDoYue: 你識講戒指太緊，要求改細半碼，再用保養同收據約星期六取。
canDoEn: Say a ring is tight, ask for half a size smaller, and collect it on Saturday under the warranty.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: This ring is too tight on my finger, and I still have the receipt.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢隻戒指戴住太緊，我仲有張收據。
dialogue.say: This ring is too tight on my finger, and I still have the receipt.

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: A tight ring can be made smaller, and the receipt shows the purchase date.
dialogue.glossYue: 太緊嘅戒指可以改細，收據上面有購買日期。
dialogue.say: A tight ring can be made smaller, and the receipt shows the purchase date.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Can you make it half a size smaller, and how long will that take?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以改細半碼，要幾耐？
dialogue.say: Can you make it half a size smaller, and how long will that take?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: That half size change is free under the warranty, and Saturday is the collection day.
dialogue.glossYue: 保養範圍內改半碼唔使錢，星期六可以取。
dialogue.say: That half size change is free under the warranty, and Saturday is the collection day.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: How long is the warranty work, and can I collect the ring on Saturday please?
dialogue.glossYue: 保養工作要幾耐，星期六可唔可以取戒指？
dialogue.say: How long is the warranty work, and can I collect the ring on Saturday please?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: The warranty covers this smaller ring, so Saturday is the right collection day for you.
dialogue.glossYue: 保養包呢隻改細嘅戒指，星期六就係取貨日。
dialogue.say: The warranty covers this smaller ring, so Saturday is the right collection day for you.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: I will bring the receipt on Saturday and collect the smaller ring then.
dialogue.glossYue: 我星期六會帶收據嚟取改細咗嘅戒指。
dialogue.say: I will bring the receipt on Saturday and collect the smaller ring then.

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Please keep that receipt with you, and Saturday is still the right collection day.
dialogue.glossYue: 請帶住張收據，星期六仍然係取貨日。
dialogue.say: Please keep that receipt with you, and Saturday is still the right collection day.
